command:
set -euo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp

echo "== align to the RSEM TRANSCRIPTOME with RSEM's own recommended settings =="
# -k 200 is the load-bearing flag: without many reported alignments per read, the EM has
# nothing to redistribute and RSEM degenerates toward the unique-only answer.
bowtie2-build -q idx.transcripts.fa txidx
bowtie2 --dpad 0 --gbar 99999999 --mp 1,1 --np 1 --score-min L,0,-0.1 \
        --no-unal -k 200 --sensitive -p 2 -x txidx -U reads.fq -S aln.sam 2> bt.log
tail -4 bt.log

NREADS=$(awk 'END{print NR/4}' reads.fq)
UNIQ=$(awk '!/^@/{c[$1]++} END{n=0; for(r in c) if(c[r]==1) n++; print n+0}' aln.sam)
MULTI=$(awk '!/^@/{c[$1]++} END{n=0; for(r in c) if(c[r]>1) n++; print n+0}' aln.sam)
test "$MULTI" -gt 0 || { echo "no multi-mapping reads -- this fixture cannot demonstrate EM"; exit 1; }

echo "== the naive method: count only uniquely-aligned reads =="
awk '!/^@/{c[$1]++; t[$1]=$3} END{ for(r in c) if(c[r]==1) u[t[r]]++
  for(k in u) printf "%s\t%d\n", k, u[k] }' aln.sam | sort > naive_unique.tsv
cat naive_unique.tsv
PCTMULTI=$(awk -v m="$MULTI" -v n="$NREADS" 'BEGIN{printf "%.1f", 100*m/n}')

{ printf 'reads\t%s\n' "$NREADS"
  printf 'uniquely_aligned\t%s\n' "$UNIQ"
  printf 'multi_aligned\t%s   (%s%% of the data -- what the naive method throws away)\n' "$MULTI" "$PCTMULTI"
} | tee align-stats.txt
# This image has NO samtools, so the SAM is handed on as-is and converted in the RSEM task.
# (A first pass did `samtools view -bS ... 2>/dev/null` here: it wrote a 0-byte BAM and the
#  failure surfaced a task later as RSEM's misleading "Fail to parse sam header".)
test -s aln.sam || { echo "aln.sam is empty"; exit 1; }
NSQ=$(awk '/^@SQ/{n++} END{print n+0}' aln.sam)
test "$NSQ" = "2" || { echo "aln.sam header has $NSQ @SQ lines, expected 2"; exit 1; }
echo "ALIGN OK"
